title: sericocalyx durus
intro: Sericocalyx durus, commonly known as the bitter stick, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its use in treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Sericocalyx durus are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents of Sericocalyx durus include essential oils, flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
